name: Itmi Vruh Reminiscent
body:
ITMI VRUH REMINISCENT
CR 10

XP 9,600
LE Medium undead (incorporeal)
Init +12; Senses darkvision 60 ft., lifesense; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 22, flat-footed 13 (+8 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 deflection)
hp 127 (15d8+45+15)
Fort +8, Ref +13, Will +15
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4, incorporeal; Immune undead traits; Weaknesses captivating memento

OFFENSE

Speed fly 40 ft. (average)
Melee touch +19/+14/+9 (2d6 cold plus memory deluge)
Special Attacks memory deluge (DC 20), possess body (DC 20)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th, concentration +13, +17 to cast defensively)

At will—mindlink

Mystic Spells Known (CL 10th, concentration +16, +20 to cast defensively)

2nd-level (at will)—hold person (DC 18), inflict pain (DC 18)
3rd-level (6/day)—slow (DC 19), suggestion (DC 19), synaptic pulse (DC 19), tongues
4th-level (3/day)—confusion (DC 20), mind thrust IV (DC 20)

STATISTICS

Str —; Dex 26 (+8); Con —; Int 14 (+2); Wis 22 (+6); Cha 16 (+3)
Base Atk +11; CMB +19; CMD 33
Feats Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth), Toughness
Skills Disguise +21, Fly +26, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Perception +30, Sense Motive +24, Stealth +32
Languages Common
SQ Hyperspace attraction

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Captivating Memento (Su)

Completely obsessed with their former life, an itmi vruh becomes fascinated with any object (or reasonable facsimile) that had a special meaning to them while alive, at the GM’s discretion. This fascination lasts as long as the itmi vruh can see the object or the fascination ends normally, whichever comes first, up to a maximum of 24 hours. Once the effect ends, the itmi vruh is immune to fascination by such objects for 24 hours.

Hyperspace Attraction (Su)

The energies that ripped the itmi vruh from their body hold a strange attraction to the creature, drawing them in like a moth to flame. If a ship exits Hyperspace into a solar system with an itmi vruh, the itmi vruh can fly toward the ship at incredible speeds, arriving at the ship in 2d20 hours.

Memory Deluge (Su)

An itmi vruh is filled with longing for their old life and projects the few memories they still retain, overwhelming many who encounter them. A creature that touches or is hit by the itmi vruh must succeed at a Will saving throw or take 1d3 Wisdom damage. This is a mindaffecting emotion effect, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

Possess Body (Su)

Once per day as a full-round action, an itmi vruh can attempt to possess the body of an adjacent living creature. The targeted creature must attempt a Will saving throw or be possessed; this functions as dominate person (caster level = the itmi vruh’s CR + its Charisma bonus). The itmi vruh does not need to know a common language to direct their victim. The itmi vruh is fully subsumed into the target’s body and can perform only mental actions, but they are immune to damage until they leave (either voluntarily, when forced out by magic, or when the host falls unconscious). Leaving a possessed creature voluntarily is a move action. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that same itmi vruh’s possess body ability for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none
